The [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] gangster [[Adamar Kirb]] established his own '''cartel''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. However, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Cold War, the cartel had broken apart into a number of smaller gangs, though its influence was still felt in the criminal underworld.<ref name="Chevin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adamar Kirb and his cartel were first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Chevin [[Species/Legends|species]] in the beta release of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. The Chevin entry was removed from the game before the game's final release in [[2011]], along with many of the entries that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but was later added back into the game with Update 2.10 on [[September 9]], [[2014]].<ref name="Chevin" />
